title: Andy Bauch: New Money, COG

prize.note: the escrow received 527,872 sats on 2017-07-01, that amount left on 2017-12-30 and was replaced by the same funder the next day, 2017-12-31, with the 428,206 sats that remains unspent today

target_format: unknown; likely a 52-character compressed WIF private key (K or L prefix), P2PKH, based on the escrow's own compressed-pubkey spend

derivation.summary: a private key encoded as a pattern of colored LEGO bricks (mechanism used for COG specifically not yet fixed: color count, cell size and payload region are all unknown), decoded back to compressed and uncompressed P2PKH addresses and compared to the escrow
derivation.certified_against: the private key behind the solved sibling piece BITCOIN $60 in the same series

difficulty_note: the general encoding method is understood and 2 of its known variants are ruled out for COG with witnessed negatives; the blocker is image fidelity (whether individual brick seams are visible), and the physical piece is held by a private collector who bought it in 2018, not the artist

leads.title: a photograph resolving individual plate seams (about 40 px/stud or more), from the piece's current owner
leads.cost: needs new information, from a specific person

leads.title: close the color-count gap in the region search (only 4 colors tried so far)
series pieces from 2017 with no public photo yet

sources.title: "New Money" show listing showing COG's $14,000 price

third_party_material: installation and press photography of the show (Vice, Gizmodo, Whitehot and others) is not included; only the 3 panel images from the artist's own site and short quoted material are used
